summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Roundhill UBER WeeklyPay ETF (UBEW) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in industrials equity. The fund is an actively managed fund seeking to provide weekly distributions and 1.2x leveraged exposure to the weekly price return of Uber Technologies, Inc. stock (NYSE: UBER) UBEW was launched on Oct 23, 2025 and is issued by Roundhill.
